description: This Java class 'ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorFactory' is responsible for parsing complex JSON field selector strings into JSON pointers, supporting nested structures and URL decoding. It provides functionality to create instances of JSON field selectors based on string input, handling delimiters, parentheses, and recursion for nested selectors.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorFactory
classes.description: Final class responsible for parsing JSON field selector strings into JSON pointers, supporting nested and URL-encoded formats. Implements validation, splitting logic, and recursion to handle complex selector syntax.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new factory instance by decoding the input string and initializing the selector parser.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelector
methods.description: Constructs and returns a JSON field selector from the parsed and split JSON keys.
